quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January-June 2026): orders received JPY 636,281 million (+41.0%), revenue JPY 490,760 million (+9.4%), operating profit JPY 50,677 million (+1.2%; operating margin 10.3% vs 11.2%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 33,574 million (+7.1%); all first-half records. quarterly_data.signal: Precision Machinery H1 FY2026: orders JPY 267,430 million (+89.3%), revenue JPY 183,693 million (+22.0%), segment profit JPY 32,534 million (+38.7%). Management states customers' fab utilization stays high, led by AI demand, and their capacity investment is likewise expanding; product orders were strong, mainly for logic/foundry, memory orders keep increasing on AI demand, and service & support orders exceeded the prior year as fab utilization recovered.

quarterly_data.signal: Revised FY2026 forecast (vs the forecast announced May 15, 2026): orders JPY 12,450 hundred million (from JPY 10,700 hundred million, +16.4%), revenue JPY 10,530 hundred million (from JPY 10,200 hundred million, +3.2%), operating profit unchanged at JPY 1,250 hundred million, profit attributable to owners of the parent unchanged at JPY 995 hundred million. Precision Machinery: orders JPY 5,500 hundred million (from JPY 4,050 hundred million), revenue JPY 4,250 hundred million (from JPY 4,000 hundred million), segment profit JPY 770 hundred million (from JPY 735 hundred million); Energy segment profit lowered to JPY 180 hundred million (from JPY 210 hundred million); the forecast includes a settlement loss from revising the retirement benefit plan. quarterly_data.signal: The 2026 Kumamoto earthquake of July 28, 2026 caused no major damage to buildings or equipment at Ebara's Kumamoto plant; the supply-chain impact was still being checked and is not reflected in the forecast published with this report.
